name: Quintus Flavius
notes: Sleeper agent embedded in Fort Vindolanda for 6 months. Works for Senator Brutus, not Tribune Lucius. Killed Sextus to protect the mission.
gm_notes: SLEEPER AGENT. Does not appear hostile — veteran soldier, quiet, twelve-year man. He is in the Tribune's entourage and oriented toward the stables. Clue: Perception DC 15 to notice his stable-orientation in Scene 1. He departs with the Tribune's escort unless identified. If the party calls him out directly (Investigation/Insight DC 14), he tries to bluff first (Deception +4 vs Insight), then flees if cornered. Combat: Dagger +4, 1d4+2 piercing. Cunning Action: Bonus action Dash/Disengage/Hide. Sneak Attack 1d6. Clue surface: Random encounter table entry 5 names him if he escaped. Surfaces again Session 4 as frumentarius advancement trigger.
